about_short_description.short_description: The Third Place helps local businesses turn every customer touchpoint into the building blocks for relationship-driven third places.

product.name: Memberships
product.description: Allows customers to commit to regular visits and receive benefits such as prepaid house accounts, members-only events, and text concierge services.

product.name: Events
product.description: Provides tools for planning, promoting, and managing events, including RSVP collection, communication, and real-time analytics.

product.name: Subscriptions
product.description: Enables businesses to offer recurring products or services, manage subscriptions, and maintain customer relationships through a dedicated portal.

product.name: E-commerce
product.description: Offers tools for selling products online, managing orders, and fulfilling complex schedules, including limited-quantity releases and time-bound menus.

product.name: Digital stamp cards
product.description: Tracks customer visits and rewards them, helping businesses gather data and build customer loyalty.
